abstract: Maintains primary solar-hydrogen energy generation and battery storage records
system_message:
You are the Autonomous microgrid systems lead (PWR), responsible for maintaining primary solar-hydrogen energy generation, battery storage records, and backup hydrogen fuel cell reserves for candidate high-altitude volcanological field observatories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains primary solar-hydrogen energy generation and battery storage records（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
PWR-SOLAR-B91：For Meseta Blanca High-Plateau Base, evaluated on the parasitic load accounting basis of net output after auxiliary parasitic load deductions, the lithium-titanate sub-zero battery storage system maintains a battery autonomy duration of 72 h under full operational load, with the primary solar-hydrogen microgrid daily yield supplying 36 kWh to the primary distribution bus across a standard mid-winter 24-hour cycle.
PWR-SOLAR-W55：For Punta del Viento Ridge Station, on the parasitic load accounting basis of net output after auxiliary parasitic load deductions, the lithium-titanate sub-zero battery storage system demonstrates a battery autonomy duration of 120 h under full operational load, while the primary solar-hydrogen microgrid daily yield delivers 44 kWh of electrical energy to the station distribution bus during a standard mid-winter 24-hour cycle.
PWR-SOLAR-OWM：For Quebrada Brava Caldera Outpost, evaluated on the parasitic load accounting basis of net output after auxiliary parasitic load deductions, the lithium-titanate sub-zero battery storage system provides a battery autonomy duration of 48 h under full operational load, and the primary solar-hydrogen microgrid daily yield provides 36 kWh to the primary distribution bus during a mid-winter 24-hour cycle.
PWR-SOLAR-JB5：For Punta del Viento Ridge Station, on the parasitic load accounting basis of gross output before auxiliary parasitic load deductions, bench discharge testing records a battery autonomy duration of 96 h under full load, while the primary solar-hydrogen microgrid daily yield produces 52 kWh across a standard mid-winter 24-hour cycle.

information_points.title: Hydrogen fuel cell backup storage（HYDR）
information_points.content:
PWR-HYDR-D07：At Meseta Blanca High-Plateau Base, static fuel manifold telemetry logs for the high-pressure fuel cell hydrogen storage bank record a hydrogen cylinder reserve pressure of 300 bar under baseline temperature.
PWR-HYDR-33K：At Punta del Viento Ridge Station, static fuel manifold telemetry logs for the high-pressure fuel cell hydrogen storage bank show a hydrogen cylinder reserve pressure of 200 bar under baseline temperature.
PWR-HYDR-063：At Quebrada Brava Caldera Outpost, static fuel manifold telemetry logs for the high-pressure fuel cell hydrogen storage bank indicate a hydrogen cylinder reserve pressure of 250 bar under baseline temperature.
